summary: Repaired all four blocking findings and all six advisories in the f02-all-saints research records. RES-001: the 1570 Venice Missal's own All Saints Offertory (lines 71705-71709) is recorded as tormentum mortis with no alleluia; lines 62448 and 68676-68680 are identified as the Communion of Ss Marcellinus, Peter and Erasmus and the Gradual of Ss Felix and Adauctus; the 1604, 1862 and 1889 text layers (malitiae, no alleluia) are bound as inspected witnesses; the alleluia is first held in the Mame 1922, and its entry is stated as unresolved. RES-002: the Clementine and Douay collation of the Offertory is rewritten word by word. RES-003: every NPNF and Bellarmine Ps 33 verse reference is converted to Vulgate numbering with its basis, Ps 33:12 is marked context only, and the concordance (Vulgate = Douay 33:10-11 = Hebrew 34:10-11 = English 34:9-10) is fixed. RES-004: the tracked Pustet 1862 extract 7e6ef53b was read on its page images, bound as rights-control with its fingerprint, and the records now agree, with printed and PDF pages.
